prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / product-mockup.
Create ONE polished portrait 3:4 promotional design poster for the existing iPhone app CircleU, high resolution, ideally 2400x3200. Not a photograph of a printed poster: the poster artwork itself fills the image. Competition presentation quality, sophisticated modern editorial layout, warm illustrated character, restrained copy.
INPUT ROLES: images 1, 2, 3 are actual Today, Journal, Practice app screen layout references; image 4 is approved-style new landscape artwork; image 5 is the exact mascot identity. Use these as references to create faithful phone mockups, not invented new app functions.
Brand: icy off-white #F5FAFF, deep navy #0D1421, royal blue #054FC9, light sky #47C7FF, tiny orange beak accents. Typography visually matching Plus Jakarta Sans: geometric, rounded, modern, clean readable. No sketch texture or glossy cartoon style.
LAYOUT: top quarter generously spaced editorial typography on very pale ice background: small penguin-head mark with wordmark "CircleU" near top left. Large bold navy headline on two lines, exact "Find your" / "words". One short supporting line below, exact "For the conversations that stay with you".
Middle and lower area: THREE elegant realistic dark-navy iPhone-like device frames with slim rounded edges and a discreet black camera island. Devices prominent and screens legible. Center phone showing Today slightly forward and larger, almost straight on. Left Journal phone slightly behind and rotated only -6 degrees. Right Practice phone slightly behind and rotated only 6 degrees. Show all three titles and important screen contents clearly, modest overlap of frames but never hide a whole screen. Consistent proportional real phone aspect ratio, no wide stubby phones, no distorted trapezoids.
TODAY SCREEN: faithfully reproduce image1 layout: penguin logo, settings, title "What’s on your mind?", landscape penguin + microphone card, three rounded outlined starter chips, white writing field, blue Save button, pill-shaped bottom nav Today / Journal / Practice. For this promotional mockup put the new writing-nook scene image4 within its landscape card instead of old flat floe scene while preserving mic control and layout. Natural short invented draft inside writing field: "I want to explain how I felt". Keep other chip labels concise and spelled correctly: "What happened?", "Who was it with?", "What do you wish you’d said?".
JOURNAL SCREEN: faithfully use image2's title, date tiles, white rounded entries card and bottom navigation. Remove transient Saved/Reflect banner for a calm journal home. Replace ALL numerical test-text entries with three brief natural invented snippets: "After our conversation", "A moment to reflect", "What I want to say". Dates 27 Oct, 26 Oct, 25 Oct. No test IDs, no repeated gibberish.
PRACTICE SCREEN: faithfully reproduce image3 title, blue card with Pingu and "Practice a message", then white saved-message bubble. Replace test message with exact "Can we split the slides?" without appended numbers. Preserve bottom Today / Journal / Practice navigation.
ENVIRONMENT: the devices rest visually on a sweeping sculpted ice ledge in a richly illustrated blue cove inspired by image4. Layered mountains, smooth water and soft morning glow form bottom half, fading to clean top text area. Subtle contact shadows ground phones. Include ONE modest foreground Pingu matching image5 sitting at bottom right holding blue journal, not covering device screens or headline. No repeated floating mascots, no confetti, no sparkles, no decorative sticker clutter.
BOTTOM: clean small navy line on quiet ice strip, exact "Write · Reflect · Practise". Generous margins. No other poster copy, no download badge, no QR code, no URL, no awards, no availability claim, no privacy claim, no logos for Apple or any competition. No sample/demo/wireframe labels inside artwork. Accurate spelling, consistent typography, harmonious blue palette, crisp polished visual hierarchy.
